customer_acme: Hey, we're seeing lots of requests to our app from our users in London hitting APAC edges and timing out (~800ms). Started yesterday after we flipped a proxy. Request IDs: r-98f7a2d, r-98f7a8
maya_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a sample curl and the full request headers? Also any proxy in front?
customer_acme: Here's a repro curl from our client stack:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -H "X-Client-Region: eu-west-2" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=ap-south-1" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
customer_acme: Our infra has an edge proxy that injects a placeholder header `X-Client-Region:` when region unknown (empty string) — might be relevant.
jonah_sre: Hmm router priority is header > query param. If proxy injects an empty header it can override query param parsing, depending on how header splitting is implemented. Do you have the raw headers from r-98f7a2d?
customer_acme: Raw headers:
`Authorization: Bearer sk-...`
`Host: api.redwood.ai`
`X-Client-Region:`
`X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4`
`User-Agent: our-sdk/2.4.0`
maya_support: That empty X-Client-Region header is the likely culprit — router treats presence of header as precedence even if value is empty, leading to fallback to default region (nearest edge = apac) in the current routing config.
lina_platform: Filing this to eng-runtime. Quick question: which SDK version are you using? There's a known change in our SDK 2.4.0 where it sends `region` as a query param and the proxy may append an empty `X-Client-Region`. Newer SDKs send region in the Authorization metadata instead.
customer_acme: We are on 2.4.0. Workaround please — customers are seeing 5xxs and billing spikes from retries.
jonah_sre: Workarounds: 1) remove the empty header at proxy (preferred), 2) force header to a valid value `X-Client-Region: eu-west-2`, or 3) toggle router header-precedence (`support-api` can flip to prefer query param) — we'll try option 3 temporarily.
maya_support: Can you grant a support window to flip precedence for your tenant? It'll be a short config change and reversible.
customer_acme: Yes please, do it. Also can you confirm retries are safe? We saw double billing on a few calls.
maya_support: Retries may be billed if upstream accepted the request. We can refund obvious duplicates after we confirm request_ids. Please DM with the list.
deploy-bot: roll/config-change: set header_precedence=false for tenant acme-corp — queued, will apply in 5m and monitor.
jonah_sre: Applied. Please attempt the failing request again and paste new request id.
customer_acme: Re-tested — request r-98f7bff went to eu edge, latency 90ms, success 200. Thanks!
maya_support: Great, we'll keep an eye on metrics and follow up with an eng patch to make router ignore empty region headers. Escalating to eng-runtime for a permanent fix. :thumbsup:
lina_platform: Eng issue created: RUNTIME-1379 "ignore-empty-x-client-region header precedence". Assigned to @eng-runtime. ETA for patch: next week.
customer_acme: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround.
